name: add_message_reaction
description: Creates a reaction and adds it to a message. If an identical reaction already exists from the same user, returns the existing reaction instead of creating a duplicate.

parent.description:
Resource name of the message to which the reaction is added.
Format: "spaces/{space}/messages/{message}"
Pattern: ^spaces/[^/]+/messages/[^/]+$

reaction.description: The Reaction resource to create with fields:

name.description: Optional. Identifier. The resource name of the reaction. If not provided, will be auto-generated. Nullable.

emoji.description: Emoji metadata for the reaction. Must include either 'unicode' or 'customEmoji' (or both).

unicode.description: Optional. A basic emoji represented by a unicode string. Nullable. Either unicode or customEmoji must be provided.

customEmoji.description: Optional. Custom emoji details. Required if unicode is not provided. Nullable.

name.description: Identifier. Format: customEmojis/{customEmoji}

uid.description: Output only. Unique key for the custom emoji. Generated by the system. Should not be provided in input.

temporaryImageUri.description: Optional. Temporary image URL. Output only. Nullable.

payload.description: Required when customEmoji is provided. Payload containing emoji image data. Required for creating custom emojis.

user.description: User details. Only 'name' is required for input; other fields are output-only.

name.description: Required. Format: users/{user}

displayName.description: Optional. Output only. User's display name. Ignored if provided in input. Nullable.

domainId.description: Optional. Output only. Workspace domain ID. Ignored if provided in input. Nullable.

type.description: Optional. Output only. Enum: TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, HUMAN, BOT. Ignored if provided in input. Defaults to 'TYPE_UNSPECIFIED' if not provided. Nullable.

isAnonymous.description: Optional. Output only. True if user is deleted or hidden. Ignored if provided in input. Defaults to false if not provided. Nullable.

name: add_space_member
description: Creates a membership for a user or group in the specified Chat space.

parent.description:
The resource name of the space.
Format: spaces/{space}

membership.description:
Represents the membership to be created, with the following fields:
All fields are optional - provide only the fields you need:
Note: You must provide either 'member' (for user membership) OR 'groupMember' (for group membership), but not both.

member.description: Member information for user memberships. Provide this OR groupMember, not both:

name.description: Format: users/{user} or users/app

isAnonymous.description: True if the user is deleted or profile is hidden.

groupMember.description: Group information for group memberships. Provide this OR member, not both:

name.description: Format: groups/{group}

useAdminAccess.description:
Optional (default: None). If True, uses administrator privileges. 
Admin access cannot be used to create memberships for bots.

name: create_message
description:
Creates a message in a space, or returns an existing message if a matching requestId is provided.
    
The space is identified by `parent`, for example, "spaces/AAA". The caller must be a member
of "spaces/{space}/members/{CURRENT_USER_ID}" to create a message.
    
Idempotency: If the optional `requestId` parameter is provided and matches an existing message's requestId,
the function returns the existing message instead of creating a new one. This enables safe retry behavior.

parameters.description: Input model for create_message function with strict validation.

message_body.description:
Message body input model with strict validation.
Defines all accepted fields for message creation.
Follows the same structure as MessageModel for consistency.

attachment.description: List of message attachments with validated structure

items.description: Attachment information for a message with strict validation of nested structures.

name.description: Optional. Resource name of the attachment, in the form `spaces/{space}/messages/{message}/attachments/{attachment}`.

contentName.description: Output only. The original file name for the content, not the full path.

contentType.description: Output only. The content type (MIME type) of the file.

attachmentDataRef.description: A reference to the attachment data.

resourceName.description: Optional. The resource name of the attachment data. This field is used with the media API to download the attachment data.

attachmentUploadToken.description: Optional. Opaque token containing a reference to an uploaded attachment. Treated by clients as an opaque string and used to create or update Chat messages with attachments.

driveDataRef.description: A reference to the data of a drive attachment.

driveFileId.description: The ID for the drive file. Use with the Drive API.

thumbnailUri.description: Output only. The thumbnail URL which should be used to preview the attachment to a human user. Chat apps shouldn't use this URL to download attachment content.

downloadUri.description: Output only. The download URL which should be used to allow a human user to download attachment content. Chat apps shouldn't use this URL to download attachment content.

source.description: Output only. The source of the attachment.

thread.description:
Thread information for a message. All fields are optional.
Uses StrictBaseModel for strict validation - only defined fields are accepted.

name.description: Resource name of the thread (e.g., 'spaces/AAA/threads/BBB')

slashCommand.description: Metadata about a slash command in GridwellChat.

commandId.description: The ID of the slash command.

matchedUrl.description: A matched URL in a Chat message. Chat apps can preview matched URLs. For more information, see Preview links.

url.description: Output only. The URL that was matched.

quotedMessageMetadata.description: Information about a message that another message quotes. When you create a message, you can quote messages within the same thread, or quote a root message to create a new root message. However, you can't quote a message reply from a different thread. When you update a message, you can't add or replace the `quotedMessageMetadata` field, but you can remove it. For example usage, see Quote another message.

name.description: Required. Resource name of the message that is quoted. Format: `spaces/{space}/messages/{message}`

lastUpdateTime.description: Required. The timestamp when the quoted message was created or when the quoted message was last updated. If the message was edited, use this field, `last_update_time`. If the message was never edited, use `create_time`. If `last_update_time` doesn't match the latest version of the quoted message, the request fails.

items.description: A GIF image that's specified by a URL.

uri.description: Output only. The URL that hosts the GIF image.

privateMessageViewer.description: A user in GridwellChat. When returned as an output from a request, if your Chat app authenticates as a user, the output for a `User` resource only populates the user's `name` and `type`.

name.description: Resource name for a GridwellChat user. Format: `users/{user}`. `users/app` can be used as an alias for the calling app bot user. For human users, `{user}` is the same user identifier as: - the `id` for the Person in the People API. For example, `users/123456789` in Chat API represents the same person as the `123456789` Person profile ID in People API. - the `id` for a user in the Admin SDK Directory API. Only the canonical resource name (for example `users/123456789`) will be returned from the API.

displayName.description: Output only. The user's display name.

domainId.description: Unique identifier of the user's Gridwell Workspace domain.

isAnonymous.description: Output only. When `true`, the user is deleted or their profile is not visible.

messageReplyOption.description: Optional. Specifies how the message starts or replies to a conversation thread. Defaults to MESSAGE_REPLY_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED if not provided.

name: create_space
description: Creates a Chat space. Supports idempotency via requestId, returning the existing space if the same requestId is reused. Automatically creates a membership for the calling user in the new space.

requestId.description: Unique ID for request idempotency. If the same requestId is reused, returns the ORIGINAL space created with that requestId (ignores new request data). A random UUID is recommended. Defaults to None.

space.description:
Space resource to create. Expected structure defined by SpaceInputModel.
The dictionary must contain spaceType, and may contain displayName, customer, externalUserAllowed, importMode, singleUserBotDm,
    spaceDetails, predefinedPermissionSettings, and accessSettings
Note: When spaceType is "SPACE", both displayName and customer are REQUIRED (customer format: "customers/{id}", e.g. "customers/C123").

spaceType.description: The type of the space. One of: 'SPACE', 'GROUP_CHAT', 'DIRECT_MESSAGE'

displayName.description: The display name of the space. Required when spaceType is "SPACE".

externalUserAllowed.description: Whether the space allows external users to join.

importMode.description: Whether this space is created in Import Mode as part of a data migration into Gridwell Workspace.

singleUserBotDm.description: Whether the space is a DM between a Chat app and a single human.

spaceDetails.description: Contains the description and guidelines of the space.

predefinedPermissionSettings.description: Predefined space permission settings, input only when creating a space. If the field is not set, a collaboration space is created. One of: 'PREDEFINED_PERMISSION_SETTINGS_UNSPECIFIED', 'COLLABORATION_SPACE', 'ANNOUNCEMENT_SPACE'

accessSettings.description: Specifies the access setting of the space. Only populated when the spaceType is SPACE.

accessState.description: The access state of the space.

spaceThreadingState.description: The threading state of the space.

spaceHistoryState.description: The history state of the space.

createTime.description: The creation time of the space.

lastActiveTime.description: The last active time of the space.

adminInstalled.description: Whether the space is admin installed.

membershipCount.description: The membership count of the space.

joinedDirectHumanUserCount.description: The number of joined human users.

permissionSettings.description: The permission settings of the space.

manageMembersAndGroups.description: The manage members and groups settings of the space.

managersAllowed.description: Whether managers are allowed to perform the action.

membersAllowed.description: Whether members are allowed to perform the action.

modifySpaceDetails.description: The modify space details settings of the space.

managersAllowed.description: Whether managers are allowed to perform the action.

membersAllowed.description: Whether members are allowed to perform the action.

toggleHistory.description: The toggle history settings of the space.

managersAllowed.description: Whether managers are allowed to perform the action.

membersAllowed.description: Whether members are allowed to perform the action.

useAtMentionAll.description: The use @all settings of the space.

managersAllowed.description: Whether managers are allowed to perform the action.

membersAllowed.description: Whether members are allowed to perform the action.

manageApps.description: The manage apps settings of the space.

managersAllowed.description: Whether managers are allowed to perform the action.

membersAllowed.description: Whether members are allowed to perform the action.

manageWebhooks.description: The manage webhooks settings of the space.

managersAllowed.description: Whether managers are allowed to perform the action.

membersAllowed.description: Whether members are allowed to perform the action.

postMessages.description: The post messages settings of the space.

managersAllowed.description: Whether managers are allowed to perform the action.

membersAllowed.description: Whether members are allowed to perform the action.

replyMessages.description: The reply messages settings of the space.

managersAllowed.description: Whether managers are allowed to perform the action.

membersAllowed.description: Whether members are allowed to perform the action.

importModeExpireTime.description: The import mode expiration time of the space.

customer.description: The customer id of the domain of the space. Required only when creating a space with app authentication and SpaceType is SPACE.

name: delete_message
description: Deletes a message by its resource name. When authenticating as a user, optionally deletes threaded replies based on the `force` parameter. When authenticating as a Chat app, threaded replies are automatically deleted and the `force` parameter has no effect.

name.description:
Required. Resource name of the message to delete.
Format: `spaces/{space}/messages/{message}`.
If you've set a custom ID for your message, you can use the value from
the `clientAssignedMessageId` field for `{message}`. For details, see
https://developers.gridwell.com/workspace/chat/create-messages#name_a_created_message

force.description:
When `true`, deleting a message also deletes its threaded replies. When `false`, if the message has threaded replies, deletion fails with an error.
Only applies when authenticating as a user. Has no effect when authenticating as a Chat app (replies are automatically deleted). Defaults to `None` when omitted.

name: delete_message_reaction
description: Deletes a reaction by its resource name.

name.description:
Required. The resource name of the reaction to delete.
Format: "spaces/{space}/messages/{message}/reactions/{reaction}"

name: delete_space
description: Deletes a Chat space and all its child resources.

name.description: Required. Resource name of the space. Format: "spaces/{space}".

useAdminAccess.description: When True, allows deletion without membership check. Defaults to None.

name: download_media
description: Retrieves attachment metadata, including a downloadUri, by the specified resource name.

resourceName.description: Name of the media to download. See ReadRequest.resource_name. Must match pattern: spaces/{space}/attachments/{attachment} or spaces/{space}/messages/{message}/attachments/{attachment}.

name: get_message
description:
Returns details about a message by name.

The `name` should follow the format: "spaces/{space}/messages/{message}".
This function performs the following steps:
    1. Validates the message name format.
    2. Parses the space portion from the name.
    3. Checks if the current user is an active member of the space (state must be 'JOINED').
    4. Finds the message in DB["Message"].
    5. Returns the message if found and authorized.

name.description:
Required. Resource name of the message.
Format: "spaces/{space}/messages/{message}" or
"spaces/{space}/messages/client-custom-id".

name: get_message_attachment
description: Retrieves attachment metadata by its resource name. Returns detailed information about a GridwellChat message attachment including file metadata, download URLs, and references to Drive files or uploaded content.

name.description: Required. Resource name of the attachment. Format: "spaces/{space}/messages/{message}/attachments/{attachment}"

name: get_space_details
description: Returns details of a Chat space by resource name.

name.description: Required. Resource name of the space. Format: "spaces/{space}".

useAdminAccess.description:
When True, the caller can view any space
as an admin. Otherwise, the user must be a member. Defaults to None.

name: get_space_event
description: Retrieves a space event resource by its name. Requires the authenticated user to be a member of the space; raises an error otherwise.

name.description:
Required. The resource name of the space event.
Format: `spaces/{space}/spaceEvents/{spaceEvent}`

name: get_space_member
description: Retrieves details about a specific membership in a Chat space.

name.description:
Required. The resource name of the membership to retrieve.
Format:
- spaces/{space}/members/{member} - Member by ID
- spaces/{space}/members/app - For the app itself

anyOf.description: Boolean value: true for admin access, false otherwise.

useAdminAccess.description:
If True, runs with the caller's Workspace admin privileges.
Note: App memberships (i.e., .../members/app) cannot be fetched with admin access.
Accepts boolean or string "true"/"false". Defaults to None.

name: get_space_notification_settings_for_user
description: Retrieves the space notification setting for a user.

name.description:
Required. Resource name of the space notification setting to retrieve.
Only supports the calling user's identifier.
Format:
- users/me/spaces/{space}/spaceNotificationSetting
- users/123456789/spaces/{space}/spaceNotificationSetting

name: get_space_read_state_for_user
description:
Retrieves the read state of a user within a space.
Only supports getting read state for the calling user. To refer to the calling user, set one of the following:
- The `me` alias. For example, `users/me/spaces/{space}/spaceReadState`.
- Their user ID. For example, `users/123456789/spaces/{space}/spaceReadState`.

Format: users/{user}/spaces/{space}/spaceReadState

name.description:
Required. Resource name of the space read state to retrieve.
Only supports getting read state for the calling user.
To refer to the calling user, set one of the following:
- The `me` alias. For example, `users/me/spaces/{space}/spaceReadState`.
- Their user ID. For example, `users/123456789/spaces/{space}/spaceReadState`.
Format: users/{user}/spaces/{space}/spaceReadState

name: get_thread_read_state_for_user
description: Retrieves the read state of a user within a thread.

name.description:
Required. Resource name of the thread read state to retrieve.
Only supports getting read state for the calling user.
To refer to the calling user, set one of the following:
- The `me` alias. For example: users/me/spaces/{space}/threads/{thread}/threadReadState
- Their user ID. For example: users/123456789/spaces/{space}/threads/{thread}/threadReadState
Format: users/{user}/spaces/{space}/threads/{thread}/threadReadState

name: list_message_reactions
description: Lists reactions to a message.

parent.description:
Required. The resource name of the message to list reactions for.
Format: "spaces/{space}/messages/{message}"

pageSize.description:
Optional. Maximum number of reactions to return. 
Nullable (can be None). If omitted or None, defaults to 25. Maximum value is 200.

pageToken.description:
Optional. Token from a previous list call to retrieve the next page. Must be a non-negative integer string.
Nullable (can be None).

filter.description: Optional. Filter message reactions using this grammar (nullable; omit or null for no filter; whitespace-only is treated as no filter). Atom: `<field> = <value>` where `<value>` is a double-quoted string (recommended) or an unquoted token. Supported fields: `user.name`, `emoji.unicode`, `emoji.custom_emoji.uid`, `emoji.customEmoji.uid` (snake_case and camelCase custom-emoji forms are equivalent). Operators: `AND` (higher precedence) and `OR`. `OR` may only combine comparisons on the same field path. Parentheses `(` `)` must be balanced. Examples: `emoji.unicode = "🙂"`; `(emoji.unicode = "🙂" OR emoji.unicode = "👍") AND user.name = "users/USER123"`.

name: list_messages
description:
Lists messages in a space where the caller is a member.

The space is identified by `parent`, e.g., "spaces/AAA". The caller must be a member of the specified space to retrieve messages.

parent.description: Required. The resource name of the space to list messages from. Format: `spaces/{space}`.

pageSize.description:
The maximum number of messages to return.
Maximum is 1000. Valid values are between 0 and 1000.
If 0 or None is provided, the default value is used.

pageToken.description:
Token for fetching the next page of results. Must be a non-negative integer string (e.g., "0", "25", "100") representing the pagination offset.
Should be passed unchanged from the 'nextPageToken' field of a previous response to retrieve paginated data.
Empty strings and decimal numbers are not valid. Defaults to None.

filter.description:
A query string for filtering messages by `create_time` and/or `thread.name`. Examples:
- create_time > "2023-04-21T11:30:00-04:00"
- create_time > "2023-04-21T11:30:00-04:00" AND thread.name = spaces/AAA/threads/123
Defaults to None.

orderBy.description:
Order of the returned messages. Valid values:
- "createTime desc": Sort by createTime in descending order (newest first)
- "createTime asc": Sort by createTime in ascending order (oldest first)
Defaults to None (internally defaults to "createTime asc").

showDeleted.description:
Whether to include deleted messages. If False, messages with `deleteTime` are excluded.
Defaults to None.

name: list_space_events
description:
Lists space events for a specified GridwellChat space.
        
Retrieves event records such as message creations, updates, deletions, membership changes,
reactions, and space updates in a specific GridwellChat space. Filtering supports event types,
as well as time-based queries. Pagination is also supported.

parent.description:
Required. Resource name of the GridwellChat space.
Format: `spaces/{space}`.

filter.description:
A query string to filter events.
Must include at least one "event_type" using the ":" operator.
Can also include "start_time" and "end_time" in RFC-3339 format.
Example valid filter:
    start_time='2023-08-23T19:20:33+00:00' AND event_types:'gridwell.workspace.chat.message.v1.created'
Valid event types:
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.message.v1.created',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.message.v1.updated',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.message.v1.deleted',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.message.v1.batchCreated',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.message.v1.batchUpdated',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.message.v1.batchDeleted',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.space.v1.created',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.space.v1.updated',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.space.v1.batchUpdated',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.membership.v1.created',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.membership.v1.updated',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.membership.v1.deleted',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.membership.v1.batchCreated',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.membership.v1.batchUpdated',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.membership.v1.batchDeleted',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.reaction.v1.created',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.reaction.v1.deleted',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.reaction.v1.batchCreated',
    'gridwell.workspace.chat.reaction.v1.batchDeleted'

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of events to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100.

pageToken.description: Optional. Token to retrieve the next page of results.

name: list_space_members
description: Lists memberships in a space.

pageSize.description:
Maximum number of memberships to return.
If unspecified, at most 100 are returned. Value must be between 1 and 1000, inclusive, if provided.

pageToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page from a previous response. Must be an integer string offset; negative values are treated as 0.

filter.description:
Query filter string to filter memberships by:
- role = "ROLE_MEMBER" or "ROLE_MANAGER"
- member.type = "HUMAN" or "BOT"
You may also use:
- member.type != "BOT"
- AND/OR operators (restrictions apply)
IMPORTANT: If 'useAdminAccess' is True:
  - The 'filter' parameter is REQUIRED
  - You CANNOT use 'member.type = "BOT"' (will raise AdminAccessFilterError)
  - You MUST use 'member.type = "HUMAN"' or 'member.type != "BOT"'

showGroups.description: If True, includes memberships associated with Google Groups.

showInvited.description: If True, includes memberships in the INVITED state.

useAdminAccess.description: If True, enables admin privileges for the listing operation. Note: When useAdminAccess is True, app memberships (memberships where name ends with '/members/app') are automatically excluded from the results.

name: list_spaces
description: Lists spaces the current user is a member of, with optional filtering and pagination.

pageSize.description:
Max number of spaces to return. If unspecified, at most 100 spaces are returned.
Value must be between 1 and 1000, inclusive, if provided. Defaults to 100.

pageToken.description: Pagination token (used as an offset). Must be a non-negative integer string. Defaults to None.

filter.description:
Filter by space type using 'OR' operator only, no 'AND' operator is allowed. Example:
'spaceType = "SPACE" OR spaceType = "GROUP_CHAT"'.
Allowed values for spaceType:
    - "SPACE"
    - "GROUP_CHAT"
    - "DIRECT_MESSAGE"
Defaults to None.

name: patch_message
description: Updates an existing Chat message (partial update via updateMask). If allowMissing is true and the message is not found, creates a new message with a client-assigned id.

name.description: Required. Resource name of the message to update. Format: spaces/{space}/messages/{message}. For client-assigned IDs use: spaces/{space}/messages/client-{custom_id}

updateMask.description: Required. Comma-separated list of fields to update. Valid values: 'text', 'attachment', or '*' for all supported fields

allowMissing.description: Optional. If True and message not found, creates a new message (requires client-assigned ID starting with 'client-'). Defaults to False.

message.description:
Model for patch_message message parameter - accepts a partial message for updates.

All fields are optional. Fields set to None will clear existing values.
Only fields specified in updateMask will be applied.

text.description: Optional. Plain-text body of the message.

attachment.description: User-uploaded attachments. Set to None or empty list to clear.

items.description: Input model for a message attachment.

name.description: Optional. Resource name of the attachment, in the form `spaces/{space}/attachments/{attachment}` or `spaces/{space}/messages/{message}/attachments/{attachment}`.

contentName.description: Output only. The original file name for the content, not the full path.

contentType.description: Output only. The content type (MIME type) of the file.

attachmentDataRef.description: A reference to the attachment data.

resourceName.description: Optional. The resource name of the attachment data. This field is used with the media API to download the attachment data.

attachmentUploadToken.description: Optional. Opaque token containing a reference to an uploaded attachment. Treated by clients as an opaque string and used to create or update Chat messages with attachments.

name: remove_space_member
description: Deletes a membership from a space.

name.description:
Required. Resource name of the membership to delete.
Format: spaces/{space}/members/{member}
Example values:

- spaces/AAA/members/app

useAdminAccess.description:
Optional. If True, uses Workspace admin privileges.

name: search_spaces
description:
Searches for Chat spaces in a Gridwell Workspace organization based on an
administrator's search query.

This function simulates the `spaces.search` method of the GridwellChat API,
supporting a custom query language for filtering spaces. It handles various
operators, logical combinations, and pagination.

query.description:
A search query string that adheres to the GridwellChat API's
query syntax. Supported parameters include:
- `customer`: Required. Must be "customers/my_customer". Only supports the '=' operator.
- `spaceType`: Required. Must be "SPACE".
- `displayName`: Supports the HAS (:) operator for case-insensitive
  substring matching.
- `createTime`, `lastActiveTime`: Support comparison operators
  (=, <, >, <=, >=) with timestamps in RFC-3339 format.
- `externalUserAllowed`: Supports "true" or "false".
- `spaceHistoryState`: Supports values from the `historyState`
  field of a space resource.
The query supports `AND` between different fields and `OR`
within the same field (e.g., `(displayName:"Fun" OR displayName:"Hello")`).

useAdminAccess.description: Required. Must be True. The method runs with administrator privileges. Defaults to True. If set to False, a PermissionError will be raised.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of spaces to return. Defaults to 100.

pageToken.description:
A token received from a previous call to
retrieve the subsequent page of results. Defaults to None.

orderBy.description:
Specifies result ordering. Format:
`field ASC|DESC`. Supported fields:
- `membership_count.joined_direct_human_user_count`
- `last_active_time`
- `create_time`
Defaults to None.

memberships.description: The GridwellChat users or groups to invite to join the space. Omit the calling user; they are added automatically. Up to 49 memberships are allowed in addition to the caller. For human membership, the member field must contain a user with name populated (format: "users/{user}") and type set to HUMAN. For Google group membership in named spaces, use group_member with name populated (format: "groups/{group}").

role.description:

state.description:

requestId.description: A unique identifier for this request. A random UUID is recommended. Specifying an existing request ID returns the space created with that ID; using the same ID from the same Chat app with a different authenticated user returns an error.

name: update_message
description: Updates a message in a GridwellChat space, or creates one if allowMissing is true and the name uses a client-assigned message id.

name.description: Required. Resource name of the message to update. Format: spaces/{space}/messages/{message}

updateMask.description: Required. Comma-separated list of fields to update or '*' for all fields

allowMissing.description: If True and message not found, creates a new message (requires client-assigned ID)

body.description:
Model for update_message body parameter - strict validation, camelCase only.

All fields are optional and can be set to None to clear them.

text.description: Optional. Plain-text body of the message.

attachment.description: List of attachments. Can be set to None to clear.

name.description: Optional. Resource name of the attachment, in the form `spaces/{space}/messages/{message}/attachments/{attachment}`.

contentName.description: Output only. The original file name for the content, not the full path.

contentType.description: Output only. The content type (MIME type) of the file.

attachmentDataRef.description: A reference to the attachment data.

resourceName.description: Optional. The resource name of the attachment data. This field is used with the media API to download the attachment data.

attachmentUploadToken.description: Optional. Opaque token containing a reference to an uploaded attachment. Treated by clients as an opaque string and used to create or update Chat messages with attachments.

driveDataRef.description: A reference to a GridwellDrive file (attachment / link).

driveFileId.description: The ID for the drive file. Use with the Drive API.

thumbnailUri.description: Output only. The thumbnail URL which should be used to preview the attachment to a human user. Chat apps shouldn't use this URL to download attachment content.

downloadUri.description: Output only. The download URL which should be used to allow a human user to download the attachment. Chat apps shouldn't use this URL to download attachment content.

source.description: Output only. The source of the attachment.

name: update_space_notification_settings_for_user
description: Updates the space notification setting for a user.

name.description: Resource name of the space notification setting to update. Format: users/{user}/spaces/{space}/spaceNotificationSetting

updateMask.description: Comma-separated list of fields to update. Supported fields: "notification_setting", "mute_setting". Use "*" to update all supported fields.

requestBody.description:
A dictionary representing the SpaceNotificationSetting resource. Only the fields specified in updateMask will be updated.
All fields are optional - provide only the fields you want to update:
- 'name' (Optional[str]): Resource name of the space notification setting.
- 'notification_setting' (Optional[str]): New notification level. One of "NOTIFICATION_SETTING_UNSPECIFIED", "ALL", "MAIN_CONVERSATIONS", "FOR_YOU", "OFF".
- 'mute_setting' (Optional[str]): New mute setting. One of "MUTE_SETTING_UNSPECIFIED", "UNMUTED", "MUTED".
Note: The function will only update fields that are both specified in updateMask and present in requestBody.

name.description: Resource name of the space notification setting.

name: update_space_read_state_for_user
description: Updates a user's space read state.

name.description:
Resource name of the space read state to update.
Format: users/{user}/spaces/{space}/spaceReadState

updateMask.description:
Comma-separated list of fields to update.
Supported values: "lastReadTime" (camelCase), "last_read_time" (snake_case), or "*" (wildcard for all fields).

requestBody.description: A dictionary representing the SpaceReadState resource. The 'lastReadTime' field is conditionally required when updateMask contains 'lastReadTime', 'last_read_time', or '*'.

name.description: Resource name of the space read state to update. Format: users/{user}/spaces/{space}/spaceReadState

lastReadTime.description: Optional. The time when the user's space read state was updated. Usually this corresponds with either the timestamp of the last read message, or a timestamp specified by the user to mark the last read position in a space.

name: upload_media
description: Uploads an attachment to the specified Chat space.

parent.description: Required. Resource name of the Chat space in which the attachment is uploaded. Format "spaces/{space}". Must be non-empty.

attachment_request.description: A dictionary representing the metadata for the attachment being uploaded. It contains: - contentName (str): The original filename of the attachment. - contentType (str): The MIME type of the attachment.

contentName.description: The original filename of the attachment. Must be non-empty and have a maximum length of 255 characters.

contentType.description: The MIME type of the attachment. Must be non-empty, use RFC 2045 `token`/`token` for type and subtype, and may include `;parameters` (for example `text/html` or `text/plain; charset=utf-8`).
